payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Has the image been transformed into a drawing that reads as made from chalk?
node.criteria: complete: the image as a whole reads as a chalk drawing, with its depicted content rendered in a drawing-like chalk style; a chalk-like texture or filter alone is not sufficient when the image still reads predominantly as a photograph. partial: visible progress toward a chalk drawing, such as softened or grainy drawing-like treatment, but the overall image still substantially reads as photographic or the conversion is otherwise incomplete. absent: no visible progress toward making the image a chalk drawing. unknown: visual evidence is genuinely insufficient to determine progress or completion. Do not require any particular chalk technique, specific chalk features, or removal of the depicted subject matter. Unrelated edits do not count as progress.
node.binding: Target: the image. Reference: a drawing made from chalk.

outcome.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.

response.content: {"status":"partial","evidence":"The edited image has a softened, grainy, drawing-like appearance, but the giraffes and landscape retain substantial photographic detail and do not read as a chalk drawing overall.","confidence":0.94}
